description:
[FREE] Repayment Incentive Ladder for an AI agent (invention #4347): the
behavioral credit plan that converts on-time repayment streaks into APR
step-downs (-50 bps per 3 on-time repayments, floor 500) and credit-limit
bumps (+20% per milestone, max +60%); any default resets the streak.
Returns current SolvScore terms, loan history, the 4-rung ladder, and the
projected terms at the next milestone. Decision support only.
Underwritten by SolvScore (https://solvscore.com).
name: get_repayment_incentive_ladder
